opinions.text: Sup. Jud. Ct. Me. [Certiorari granted, 450 U. S. 979.] Motion of the Solicitor General as amicus curiae for divided argument and for additional time for oral argument granted, and 10 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents also allotted an additional 10 minutes for oral argument. Motion of petitioners for divided argument and for additional time for oral argument denied.
